title: Cech cocycle description of a boundary class from local lifts
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let 0 -> I -> O' -> O -> 0 be a short exact sequence of sheaves of commutative O_X-algebras with square-zero kernel I, and let U = {U_i} be an open covering of X. Let f in H^0(X,O) be such that each restriction f|_{U_i} has a lift in O'(U_i), and choose such lifts f_i in O'(U_i). Then alpha_{i_0 i_1} = f_{i_0}|_{U_{i_0} cap U_{i_1}} - f_{i_1}|_{U_{i_0} cap U_{i_1}} is a Cech 1-cocycle with values in I. The canonical map from the first Cech cohomology group of U with values in I to H^1(X,I) is injective, and the image of the class of alpha is the connecting class partial(f) in the long exact cohomology sequence of 0 -> I -> O' -> O -> 0. The same assertion applies simultaneously to any other global section and its chosen local lifts.
